strategies.name: conservation
strategies.description: Orchestra's own: stocks by conservation over counters, rates fitted by the exact point-process likelihood

strategies.name: change_price
strategies.description: an honest BIC price for changes in the outside inflow, with a gate

strategies.name: floors
strategies.description: rates floored at zero and outflows capped by what a stock holds (hinge columns)

strategies.name: gated
strategies.description: a behaviour-consistency gate before the judge

strategies.name: gated_no_high
strategies.description: `gated` without the runs from high states

strategies.name: gradient
strategies.description: numbers (and a generous structure) fitted through a differentiable simulator (research)

strategies.name: held_out
strategies.description: candidates chosen by blocked cross-validation

strategies.name: held_out_blend
strategies.description: the in-sample judge nudged by the held-out error

strategies.name: hidden_delays
strategies.description: unmeasured stocks as delayed copies of a level

strategies.name: impulses
strategies.description: one-step pulses and short bursts found jointly with each row

strategies.name: inflow_attribution
strategies.description: flagged rows refitted: drains within stretches, inflow with the drain held

strategies.name: inflow_attribution_both
strategies.description: repaired and unrepaired candidates side by side

strategies.name: inflow_attribution_refine
strategies.description: inflow attribution on the chosen model only

strategies.description: effect_hats with outside inflows read as a schedule or a measured input times a table of a stock (gate.py)

strategies.name: latent_eras
strategies.description: unannounced regimes found in the rows, then fitted as eras

strategies.name: loop_transit
strategies.description: realistic_hats with hidden stages that close a loop: injections in the pair's rows, the return move refitted with shared noise

strategies.name: mass_balance
strategies.description: hidden stocks reconstructed from a unit's mass balance (Kalman filter)

strategies.name: mass_balance_all
strategies.description: `mass_balance` tried on every candidate

strategies.name: matrix
strategies.description: the main line: one-step regression per stock, candidates chosen by multi-step behaviour; outside flows only where the case declares its boundary, else priced as boundary claims (boundary.py)

strategies.name: numopt_bo
strategies.description: `numopt` with Bayesian optimisation

strategies.name: numopt_cma
strategies.description: `numopt` with CMA-ES (research)

strategies.name: numopt_fd
strategies.description: the matrix model's numbers (and optional terms) fitted by multi-step error, finite differences

strategies.name: numopt_fd_coarse
strategies.description: `numopt_fd` with coarse, learnable outside-inflow pieces

strategies.description: `numopt_fd` with outside inflows re-measured at every evaluation

strategies.name: numopt_lbfgs
strategies.description: `numopt` with L-BFGS-B

strategies.name: numopt_nm
strategies.description: `numopt` with Nelder-Mead

strategies.name: numopt_powell
strategies.description: `numopt` with Powell

strategies.name: odefit
strategies.description: per-step models fitted by output error (segment starts estimated), products where earned; the main line kept where it predicts better

strategies.name: output_error
strategies.description: the chosen model's rates refined by multi-step error

strategies.name: paced_moves
strategies.description: the matrix read as stoichiometry x rates: paced moves and (option `paced_readings`) gap inflows

strategies.name: periodic_inflows
strategies.description: outside inflows as a repeating profile

strategies.name: piece_proof
strategies.description: candidates judged with outside inflows they did not tailor

strategies.description: the matrix with the pieces-gate fix (`pieces_gate = "noise"`)

strategies.name: recession
strategies.description: drains measured on quiet steps (no inflow), as extra candidates

strategies.name: row_crossover
strategies.description: the judge's pick with rows swapped in from other candidates where the model behaves better

strategies.name: schedules

strategies.name: shared_noise
strategies.description: moves, links and co-flows told apart by shared draws in the residuals

strategies.name: sindy
strategies.description: PySINDy with SD-shaped libraries and conservation constraints (research)

strategies.name: starved_coflows
strategies.description: co-flows fitted on the steps where the used stock did not run dry

strategies.name: symbolic
strategies.description: effect curves found by a symbolic search, offered as candidates

strategies.name: symbolic_anchor
strategies.description: symbolic effects accepted only by an addition test inflow pieces cannot fake

strategies.name: unified
strategies.description: work in progress: one model class, one data model and one objective (J); only the objective and its test are built, identify() is the main line's
